title: tooling(objectui-readiness 2): readers of pnpm-workspace.yaml, turbo.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and the root manifest resolve the workspace root upward (objectstack#25723)
body:
Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25723 (sub-issue 2b of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25677, the objectui → objectstack `ui/` merge). Follow-up of #13472.

## What
Adds `scripts/workspace-root.mjs` (Node builtins only, importable before `pnpm install`) and its `.d.mts` twin: `workspaceRoot()`, `workspaceGlobs()`, `lockfilePath()`, `rootManifest()`, `uiTurboConfigPath()`, `uiScopedTurboConfig()`. Every reader of `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, the root `package.json` and `turbo.json` under `scripts/`, `scripts/__tests__/`, two package tests and the five e2e specs resolves those files through it. The three ad-hoc `packages:` parsers are unified (union of their refusals). `check-ui-root-lookups` learns the `marker-walk` shape that let the e2e `REPO_ROOT` IIFEs escape #13472, with self-test cases. Standalone behaviour is byte-identical: every helper branch is the identity when `<uiRoot>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` exists.

## Why
Once objectui is `ui/` of the objectstack monorepo, the workspace root, lockfile and overrides live one directory up and `turbo.json` is parked as `turbo.objectui.json` (a nested turbo.json must `extends` the root). Readers that assumed those files at `uiRoot()` fail with ENOENT (measured on the verification PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#25718: Type Check UI at `check:side-effects-array`, Build & E2E UI at the first e2e spec, 15 of 16 Test UI shards) or walk up to the wrong root (five e2e specs). This PR makes them layout-aware ahead of the import.

## Verification
| command | standalone | merged layout (`ui/` in objectstack, scratch copy of the verification tree) |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm check:ui-root-lookups` / `--self-test` | 0 / 0 (17 cases) | 0 |
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__` | 0 (195 files, 5772 tests) | card's failing files + every touched test: all reader reds green; 10 remaining reds are the spec-pin gates (spec is `workspace:` post-import), the QUICK_REFERENCE script list, the vendor-chunk arm, one dom test — none a root-file read, all carried on objectstack#25697 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli test` | 0 (415) | `workspace-vite.test.ts` green |
| `pnpm check:side-effects-array` | 0 | 0 |
| `pnpm check:docs-route-closure` | 0 | 0 |
| `pnpm check:lockfile-dedupe` / `check:lockfile-integrity` / `check:installed-pin-claims` | 0 / 0 / 0 | n/a (the pin gates presuppose the pin) |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` / `type-check:e2e` | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 |
| `pnpm lint:coverage`, `lint:root`, the pre-push gate list | 0 | — |
| `playwright test --list --project=chromium` | 0 (78 tests) | 0 (78 tests, 0 ENOENT) |

The same patch is on the verification branch as objectstack commit 1cade6932a (run 3 of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25718).

## Landing
Tooling and tests only; no product code (`packages/cli/src/utils/workspace-vite.ts`, `app-generator.ts` unchanged); no governed surface touched. Changeset `.changeset/25723-workspace-root-readers.md` with empty frontmatter — present because two package test files under `src/` changed; releases nothing. Draft until CI is green; then the epic PM asks for review.
